items.distractor_fact: የአካባቢው ነዋሪ ቤት ውስጥ ያለው የግል ቴርሞሜትር በዚያው ጠዋት {D}°ሴ አሳይቶ ነበር።
items.gloss_en: A local resident's personal thermometer at home showed {D}°C that same morning. (Invariant: the °C unit symbol is written right after the numeral like an abbreviation and never inflects, for any integer.)
items.entity_note: a resident's personal thermometer (a person-owned instrument), unlike the first sentence's place-owned village gauge

items.distractor_fact: በዚያው ቀን ሌላ ባለሀብት ይዞት የነበረው አክሲዮን ዋጋ {D} ብር ደርሶ ተዘጋ።
items.gloss_en: That same day, a different investor's holding closed at a stock price of {D} birr. (Invariant: the count noun ብር follows the bare numeral and never inflects, for any integer.)
items.entity_note: a different individual investor (a person), unlike the first sentence's different company (an organisation)

items.distractor_fact: የመስኖ ባለስልጣኑ የቁጥጥር ጣቢያ በዚያው ቀን የውሃ መጠን {D} ሜትር አስመዘገበ።
items.gloss_en: The irrigation authority's monitoring station recorded a water level of {D} meters that same day. (Invariant: ሙቴፕ follows the bare numeral and never inflects, for any integer.)
items.entity_note: the irrigation authority (an organisation), unlike the first sentence's different dam (a place)

items.distractor_fact: ሌላ ተራራ ወጣት በተለየ ጉዞ ላይ የደረሰው ከፍታ {D} ሜትር ነበር።
items.gloss_en: A different young mountain climber, on a separate trek, reached a height of {D} meters. (Invariant: ሙቴፕ follows the bare numeral and never inflects, for any integer.)
items.entity_note: a different climber (a person), unlike the first sentence's different mountain peak (a place)

items.distractor_fact: አንድ መንግሥታዊ ያልሆነ ድርጅት ባደረገው ቆጠራ፣ በሚያገለግለው አካባቢ የነዋሪ ቁጥር በዚያው ዓመት {D} ደረሰ።
items.gloss_en: By an NGO's own count, the population in the area it serves reached {D} that same year. (Invariant: bare numeral stands alone as the population figure, no classifier, for any integer.)
items.entity_note: an NGO's own service area (an organisation), unlike the first sentence's different town (a place)

items.distractor_fact: ሌላ ቅርንጫፍ በዚያ ወቅት ደንበኞች ወደ ሂሳብ ያስገቡት ጠቅላላ መጠን {D} ብር ነበር።
items.gloss_en: A different branch's total of customer deposits during that period amounted to {D} birr. (Invariant: ብር follows the bare numeral and never inflects, for any integer.)
items.entity_note: a different bank branch (an organisation), unlike the first sentence's different customer (a person)

items.distractor_fact: በዚያ ወር ሌላ ግለሰብ ነጋዴ ያገኘው ገቢ {D} ብር ነበር።
items.gloss_en: That month, a different individual trader earned income of {D} birr. (Invariant: ብር follows the bare numeral and never inflects, for any integer.)
items.entity_note: an individual trader (a person), unlike the first sentence's different company (an organisation)

items.distractor_fact: ሌላ ተጫዋች በዚያ ወቅት ያስቆጠረው ግብ ብዛት {D} ነበር።
items.gloss_en: A different player scored a total of {D} goals during that season. (Invariant: ብዛት follows the bare numeral and never inflects, for any integer.)
items.entity_note: a different individual player (a person), unlike the first sentence's different team (an organisation)

items.distractor_fact: በዚያ ወቅት ሌላ ኩባንያ ያገኘው ትርፍ {D} ብር ነበር።
items.gloss_en: During that period, a different company earned a profit of {D} birr. (Invariant: ብር follows the bare numeral and never inflects, for any integer.)
items.entity_note: a different company (an organisation), unlike the first sentence's different investor (a person)

items.distractor_fact: በተለየ ውድድር ላይ ተመዝግቦ የነበረው ጠቅላላ ምት ብዛት {D} ነበር፣ የዚያ ውድድር ፓር ግን አልተገለጸም።
items.gloss_en: In a separate tournament, the total number of strokes recorded was {D}; that tournament's par is not stated. (Invariant: ብዛት follows the bare numeral and never inflects, for any integer.)
items.entity_note: a different tournament, i.e. a different series/edition of the competition, whose par is unstated -- differs in kind from the first sentence's different player on a different course

items.distractor_fact: ሌላ አየር መንገድ ድርጅት የሚያሰራው በረራ ትክክለኛ መነሻ ሰዓት፣ በደቂቃ ተቆጥሮ፣ {D} ነበር፣ የዚያ በረራ መርሐ ግብር ግን አልተገለጸም።
items.gloss_en: A flight operated by a different airline had an actual departure time, counted in minutes, of {D}; that flight's schedule is not stated. (Invariant: bare numeral stands alone as the minute count, for any integer.)
items.entity_note: a different airline (an organisation), unlike the first sentence's different flight on a different route (a series)

items.distractor_fact: የቁጥጥር ላብራቶሪ በተለየ ናሙና ላይ ያደረገው ንባብ {D} ክፍል ነበር፣ የዚያ ናሙና መሠረት ደረጃ ግን አልተገለጸም።
items.gloss_en: A monitoring laboratory's reading on a separate sample was {D} units; that sample's baseline is not stated. (Invariant: ክብል follows the bare numeral and never inflects, for any integer.)
items.entity_note: a monitoring laboratory (an organisation), unlike the first sentence's different instrument

items.distractor_fact: ሌላ ተጫዋች በዚያ ጨዋታ ያስቆጠረው ግብ ብዛት {D} ነበር።
items.gloss_en: A different player scored a total of {D} goals in that match. (Invariant: ብዛት follows the bare numeral and never inflects, for any integer.)
items.entity_note: an individual player (a person), unlike the first sentence's third team (an organisation)

items.distractor_fact: ሌላ ቡድን በዚያ ውድድር ያገኘው ጠቅላላ ነጥብ {D} ነበር።
items.gloss_en: A different team earned a total of {D} points in that competition. (Invariant: ነጥብ follows the bare numeral and never inflects, for any integer.)
items.entity_note: a different team (an organisation), unlike the first sentence's third competitor (a person)

items.distractor_fact: ሌላ ግለሰብ ባለሀብት በዚያ ወቅት ያገኘው ገቢ {D} ብር ነበር።
items.gloss_en: A different individual investor earned income of {D} birr in that period. (Invariant: ብር follows the bare numeral and never inflects, for any integer.)
items.entity_note: an individual investor (a person), unlike the first sentence's third company (an organisation)
